lines.text: Many learners say: I was born in 1998 year.

native.tip: 中文说“一九九八年”，“年”一定要说。英语里直接说数字，不加 year。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I was born in 1998 year.”😅 中文年份要加“年”，英语直接说数字：“I was born in 1998.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“I was born in 1998.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Chinese says the word for year after the number, but English does not.
en.caption: Do you say “I was born in 1998 year.” 😅 English does not say year after the number: “I was born in 1998.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
